name: claude-tag-plugins
description: Plugins that connect Claude Tag to common SaaS services, plus charting and configuration helpers.

plugins.name: asana
plugins.description: Access Asana tasks, projects, sections, and comments — list, search, create, and update.

plugins.name: bigquery
plugins.description: Access Google BigQuery datasets and tables — run SQL, fetch schemas, and manage jobs.

plugins.name: confluence
plugins.description: Access Confluence pages, spaces, and comments — search, read, create, and update content.

plugins.name: datadog
plugins.description: Access Datadog logs, metrics, monitors, dashboards, SLOs, events, traces, and incidents.

plugins.name: enterprise-search
plugins.description: Access your company's knowledge index — search across all connected sources, read documents, and submit relevance feedback.

plugins.name: google-drive
plugins.description: Access Google Drive files and folders — search, read, upload, share, and export Docs and Sheets.

plugins.name: grafana
plugins.description: Access Grafana dashboards, datasource queries, alerts, annotations, and folders.

plugins.name: hubspot
plugins.description: Access HubSpot contacts, companies, deals, and tickets — search and manage CRM records.

plugins.name: jira
plugins.description: Access Jira issues, sprints, and comments — search with JQL, create, and transition issues.

plugins.name: linear
plugins.description: Access Linear issues, projects, cycles, and teams.

plugins.name: notion
plugins.description: Access Notion pages, databases, and blocks — search, read, create, and update content.

plugins.name: pagerduty
plugins.description: Access PagerDuty incidents, on-call schedules, escalation policies, and services.

plugins.name: redshift
plugins.description: Access Amazon Redshift — run SQL queries, poll results, and browse schemas and tables.

plugins.name: salesforce
plugins.description: Access Salesforce records — run SOQL queries, create, read, update, and delete objects.

plugins.name: sentry
plugins.description: Access Sentry issues, events, projects, releases, and stats.

plugins.name: snowflake
plugins.description: Access Snowflake — run SQL statements, poll and fetch results, and browse warehouses.

plugins.name: claude-tag-data-viz
plugins.description: Compose polished charts from tabular data — PNG, SVG, or self-contained interactive HTML.

plugins.name: claude-tag-troubleshoot
plugins.description: Guides configuration of @Claude agents — agent scopes, identity profiles, connections, repos, and instructions — and diagnoses plugin/skill loading problems from inside a running session.
